title: Radiography/Fluoroscopy, Tomography — Minimum Requirements
notes: Section opens with a cross-reference: 'Other requirements are as stated under "Minimum requirements for all types of Health Institutions"' (page 33) — see the common all-institutions module; not repeated as items here.

items.requirement: Combined Radiography and Fluoroscopy space requirement is at least 20 square meters.

measurement.dimension: combined radiography and fluoroscopy room floor area
measurement.expected: at least 20 square meters as stated

items.requirement: Separate toilets with hand-washing stations shall be provided with direct access from each fluoroscopic room so that a patient can leave the toilet without having to re-enter the fluoroscopic room.
Rooms used only occasionally for fluoroscopic procedures shall be permitted to use nearby patient toilets if they are located for immediate access.
items.applicability: rooms used only occasionally for fluoroscopic procedures
items.alternatives: nearby patient toilets permitted for rooms used only occasionally for fluoroscopic procedures, if located for immediate access

items.requirement: Patient gowning area with safe storage for valuables and clothing shall be provided in the facility.
At least one space should be large enough for staff-assisted dressing.
